assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: C01 art-direction reference for Fortress AI, an original bright cartoon 2D artillery and fortress building game.
Create one polished wide 16:9 side-on playable battlefield concept illustration, ideally 1536x864. It is a game art target, not a website, menu or sprite sheet.
Scene: cheerful blue sky, a small amount of fluffy cloud, a distant muted blue-green hill ridge. Foreground terrain is a continuous grassy earth cutaway across the bottom, visibly supporting every playable object. Playable terrain and fortresses occupy the important central and lower area. Avoid a huge empty sky.
Left: a charming compact king with expressive face, simple gold crown, short red cape, blue tunic and sturdy boots stands safely inside a small fortress built from a few clearly readable wood and stone structural pieces. A chunky wood-and-blue-metal cartoon cannon stands on visible ground nearby.
Right: a blue-team fortress is struck at one support by a cannonball. Show one readable physical chain reaction, with a tilted roof beam, several stone chips, wood splinters and a small smoke puff. Keep the king safe from graphic injury. The cause and consequence must be visually understandable.
Style: premium smooth hand-painted 2D cartoon game illustration with clean confident contours, broad readable color groups, rounded chunky geometry, limited fine texture. Expressive original characters, friendly energetic mood with convincing weight. Warm sunlight from upper left. Green grass, warm honey wood, warm neutral stone, blue/red team accents, restrained gold.
Composition must use a flat side-view gameplay camera; no isometric board, no overhead or distant cinematic camera. Kings and cannons must be large enough to recognize when the image is viewed on a phone. Keep background less saturated and lower contrast than gameplay objects. Leave only narrow unobtrusive top and bottom breathing space for future HUD.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, buttons, HUD, border, presentation panels, pixel-art filter, photorealism, ornate dark-fantasy UI, black vignette, or borrowed franchise characters.

Subject: one charming compact brave king, original design. Large expressive eyes/eyebrows, round warm nose, friendly brown moustache and short brown beard, compact gold crown with three readable red jewels, blue tunic, simple gold clasp and belt buckle, short red cape, sturdy dark boots. Preserve a clear face silhouette and broad color groups readable at just 48 to 64 pixels tall.
Pose: neutral ready standing, facing RIGHT in a strict side-on gameplay view with the face slightly turned enough to show expression; BOTH feet rest on the same horizontal baseline. Hands relaxed and separated from the torso; arms and cape have clear shapes for later cutout animation. Nothing held.
Style: match reference's polished smooth illustrated cartoon game assets, clean crisp contours, chunky rounded proportions, restrained fine texture, soft upper-left sunshine. Not photorealistic, no pixel-art filter, no glossy plastic 3D render.
Framing: square 1024x1024, only ONE complete king, centered, full crown/cape/hands/boots visible, minimum 12% fully transparent padding on all four sides. Real RGBA alpha transparency.
NO ground, platform, shadow, smoke, effects, props, throne, shield, cannon, extra characters, costume variants, animation grid, text, labels, letters, watermark, black/white/checkerboard background. This is the neutral master sprite, not an action pose.

Use case: stylized-concept.

Input image 1: exact cannon carriage alignment and material reference. Input image 2: battlefield style reference. Generate only a NEW standalone barrel compatible with image 1; neither reference is the edit target.
ONE chunky blue-gray cartoon metal cannon barrel, pointing HORIZONTALLY RIGHT. Pure level side-view like the provided carriage: cylindrical tube, broad clean silhouette, a dark visible right-facing muzzle opening, simple tasteful gold bands, dark teal-blue metal shadows, upper-left sunlight and illustrated highlights matching the reference. assets.refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: corrected distant-fortress landmark for Fortress AI.
Image 1 is the edit target: fortress on transparent background. Image 2 is the distance/color reference: muted hills.
Keep the same original castle identity, three-tower silhouette, blue roofs and red pennants, full side/front architectural elevation, flat horizontal bottom baseline and TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. Change its treatment so it is a FAR BACKGROUND landmark, not foreground architecture.
Simplify drastically into large quiet cartoon color shapes. Remove individual brick outlines, tiny masonry cracks and grass blades. Remove the three large hanging crown banners completely. Make windows muted soft pale cream rather than bright glowing yellow. Desaturate the stone and roofs toward the blue-green atmospheric colors of image 2, soften all internal contrast, eliminate bright specular highlights and dark black outlines. The finished fortress should be clearly recognizable but visually quieter and less detailed than a playable character, readable at 140 pixels wide.
Reframe the entire complete castle inside square canvas with at least FIFTEEN PERCENT clear transparent margin on ALL FOUR SIDES. Preserve all flag tips and full base. Leave everything outside the castle genuinely transparent; do NOT add fog, sky, hill, cloud, ground island, gradient rectangle or any new scene. No new objects, labels, words, grid or watermark.
